recentItems.title: 'Gogos' dribble their way to France
recentItems.description:
From the heart of Tshwane in Gauteng to the fields of France, the Golden League Gogos have stepped onto the global stage to represent Africa at the Four Continents Football Tournament, proving that sport and healthy living have no age limit.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Reporters from three US news outlets return to work after being banned by President Trump
recentItems.description:
Reporters from three US news outlets are back inside the White House after being banned by President Donald Trump for coverage he deemed to be "fake".

A federal court ordered the Trump administration to reverse its ban on CNN, Politico and M.S. NOW, but reporters were initially denied entry to the White House grounds on Thursday morning.

It meant that no American TV network aired any live footage of Trump welcoming China's president, Xi Jinping, to the White House.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: 2026 LGE | IEC in the Western Cape says it will start printing ballot papers on Monday
recentItems.description:
The IEC in the Western Cape says it will start printing ballot papers on Monday. 

This comes as various contesting political parties and independents signed the IEC's Electoral Code of Conduct in Bellville, ahead of the November 4 polls. 

SABC reporter Vanessa Poonah and video journalist Clinton Cerf have more. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: ANC President Cyril Ramaphosa on the campaign trail in eThekwini metro
recentItems.description:
ANC president Cyril Ramaphosa is on a campaign trail in the eThekwini metro in KwaZulu-Natal over the next two days. 

The ANC lost its outright majority in the metro in the 2021 Local Government Elections. It is now governing the city through a coalition. 

This Friday, Ramaphosa will be in Hammarsdale, where he is expected to engage with residents and ANC supporters. 

ANC provincial task team convenor Mike Mabuyakhulu says the party is expecting the outcomes of the 2026 municipal elections to be different from the declines of the previous two polls.

Nonhlakanipho Magwaza is there...

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: GBVF | Men in Gauteng march against GBV and femicide: SABC News speak to some protesters
recentItems.description:
Some women and men around Kwa-Thema in Ekurhuleni have come out to walk against Gender-Based Violence and Femicide. 

After nine women were found killed and dumped in various parts of the city, the residents say the spate of violence cannot continue under their watch. 

The men-led solidarity walk, organised by the Department of Community Safety, is held under the theme "men leading a united stand against Gender-Based Violence and Femicide". 

The men have called on others to stand against the killing of women.

Let's take you there live. SABC reporter Calvin Dludla is on the ground...

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Suspect linked to fatal ambush of two Crime Intelligence officers in Mount Edgecombe shot dead
recentItems.description:
Police say a suspect who was wanted for the murder of two Crime Intelligence members has been killed in a shootout with officers in Inanda, KwaZulu-Natal. 

One officer was wounded in the incident, which happened on Friday morning. 

The Crime Intelligence officers, Captain Cornelius Nel and Sergeant Mandla Khuzwayo, were gunned down during an ambush in April.

Mlondi Radebe has more on the story.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Gauteng EMS Services | Health Dept assures public emergency response continues
recentItems.description:
Gauteng Health says EMS services remain uninterrupted despite disciplinary action against 21 officials accused of failing to complete their scheduled working hours. 

The department says no EMS officials are currently suspended and that measures are in place to ensure emergency calls continue to receive a response. 

For the latest on the matter, we're joined in the studio by Gauteng Health spokesperson Steve Mabona.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Khuselo Diko responds to claims she's protecting Police Minister Senzo Mchunu
recentItems.description:
The Activists and Citizens Forum has accused ANC Member of Parliament, Khusela Diko, of protecting Police Minister Senzo Mchunu at the expense of suspended National Police Commissioner Fannie Masemola. 

Mchunu is on special leave, while charges against Masemola have been dropped.

The forum says Diko, who is also a member of Parliament's Ad Hoc Committee, is trying to shift the blame of wrongdoing in the SAPS to Masemola, who Mchunu allegedly forced to disband the Political Killings Task Team.

Ms Diko joins us now...


For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Ramokgopa outlines plans for Eskom, reappointment of Board chair Mteto Nyati
recentItems.description:
Electricity and Energy Minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa has briefed the media on Eskom's Board leadership, governance and government's expectations for the power utility.

The briefing comes as Eskom works to strengthen its governance and improve its performance, while efforts continue to ensure a more reliable electricity supply.

For the latest on the Minister's briefing, we cross live to SABC News Economics Reporter Katlego Legodi in Pretoria.
